verdict.rationale: Data portability from an online account is a fair question for a government service with user accounts, so the axis applies. The pack only lists a 'Tax record (transcript)' service by title, with nothing on bulk export, completeness, or open formats. MeF's XML format [irs-supp-5] is an inbound filing channel for credentialed providers, not user data export, so it earns no credit.
